proposal: Add a YouTube-local in-memory continuity pocket attached to the already-native-approved recording. Before a transition retain only each track's latest complete moof+mdat and current incomplete fragment, starting at a moof received after approval. This small rolling scratch covers an audio fragment that overlaps the video format boundary; it is not pre-start recording and is never durable on its own.

On the first supported format boundary freeze the pocket into transition mode, bound to the exact current video/MediaSource/channel and current recording object. Discard old-config fragments for every changed track; retain unchanged-track overlap and collect newly observed complete A/V fragments during native finish and automatic stability. Init identity is immutable per stored fragment and captured MIME/track mapping must remain exact.

Enforce a32MiB aggregate raw-byte budget including incomplete fragments and retained entries, maximum128 complete entries,4096 copied pieces and a15sec transition lifetime from the first format boundary through successor native approval, not from the delayed native reply. Existing append16MiB and transport queue64MiB bounds remain. No allocation/copy waits inside appendBuffer, no payload/config hash logging. Stop and release memory on overflow, malformed fragment sequence, unsupported configuration, changed source/document/channel, encryption/ad, explicit stop or cancelled exact arm.

Start successor through the unchanged fresh native arm/automatic readiness path using a synchronous snapshot of the current init per track. Before any encoded_append, native encoded_begin must approve that same init and exact current owner/epoch. Queue retained complete entries once, in their observed order, ahead of live appends through the existing serial ACK queue. Existing native validators reject any mismatch; no JS normalization or timestamp rewrite.

Preserve an in-flight fragment across the handoff without forwarding its tail twice: a fragment whose moof began in the pocket remains pocket-owned until its complete mdat, then enters the successor queue exactly once. A new fragment after handoff enters the normal live path. Snapshot init/MIME and recheck on each admission to prevent a second adaptation while begin is pending from mixing configurations.

User stop or cancel-before-finish-reply clears the pocket and cancels later continuation even when the fresh nonce has not arrived. Native exact-owner fencing still rejects stale begin. If a rejected/expired continuation cannot be completed, retain the old result and expose the existing bounded preparation failure rather than quietly resuming after discarded media.
